handback.t:
### Spec Compliance
- ✅ Menu groups derive from NAV_GROUPS (ids, order, membership). GROUPS is built by mapping NAV_GROUPS (views/menu.ts:1071-1081); MENU_SECTIONS only supplies the sub-split and any omitted page is appended to the last section. group-scheme.spec.ts:1217-1238 locks this.
- ✅ Help-index groups derive from NAV_GROUPS: HELP_GROUPS = ['Start', ...NAV_GROUPS titles, 'Console'], GROUP_BLURB keyed by the same names (help-docs.ts:188-205). Guides re-filed under the group of the page they describe, checked against VIEW_TOPIC.
- ✅ One label per page. Menu-only names (Claims Board, Plugins & Mods, Swarm Topology, etc.) are gone; menu items use the VIEWS label via itemOf. Boot log, AREA_VIEW, SCAN_NAMES and self-check moved to the same names.
- ✅ Learning vs Neural resolved: page label now "Neural Lab" (short Nrl), "Learning" stays; spec asserts the pair.
- ✅ Non-page topics (control, updates, headless, verify, troubleshoot) stay in "Console".
- ✅ Scope: plugins/ruflo-console only, no new deps.
- ⚠️ "One label everywhere" is not fully met: stale old names remain in help text, README and a few labels (Issues 1-3).

Named risks:
- (a) Edited kit tests: every edit holds against the new labels/groups. nav.test.ts:1352 is right (tab uses label, now "Neural Lab"). views.test.ts:1549 `toContain('Swarm')` is correct but now vacuous (SWARM group text matches anyway). nav.test.ts:59 (`tab-memory`) is vacuous too, since hidden pages always render tab-* keys (views/nav.ts:111). The six-string grep over tests/*.test.ts found no un-updated expectation. Only wf-wire.spec.ts:111 has a stale title.
- (b) Lookups: console_open takes page ids only (model-tools.ts:391), so unaffected; saved state, palette ids and help topic ids are ids, unaffected. viewOf matches exact label, so one command breaks (Issue 1).
- (c) Coverage: every page appears exactly once; all non-menu pages covered by MENU_SECTIONS plus the append-rest rule; commands close the last group; spec checks membership and duplicates.
- (d) Terse titles MIND/SAFETY/NETWORK: acceptable. The brief wants one set of group names, and the sub-section rules (protect/observe, network/extend) keep the old meaning visible. Small loss of descriptiveness, not a forbidden regression.

### Strengths
- One source of truth; the derived menu repairs both missing and misplaced pages, not just the happy path.
- Collapsing NAV_ACCENT into ACCENT removes a duplicate mapping.
- The spec covers derivations well and fences retired names.
- Each guide's group was audited against its page (watch, room, skills moved to their page's group).
- Rename carried into SCAN_NAMES, NAME_WIDTH, AREA_VIEW and the self-check.

### Issues
#### Critical
None.

#### Important
1. `/ruflo learning lab` and the menu prompt "learning lab" now fail. viewOf (state.ts:93-96) matches id, key, exact label or id prefix; "Learning Lab" was the exact label of `neural`, so it now returns null. The menu answers `no area "learning lab"`, and /ruflo parses it as unknown (commands.ts:106, bindings.ts:265). The old help text taught that name. Fix: add a small alias in viewOf for the old name (probably "memory lab" too) and correct the help line. `neural` and key `l` still work, so this is a convenience break, not a dead page.
2. help-topics-core.ts:76 still says "l learning lab · v vector lab …", contradicting the one-label goal. The new retired-name spec missed it because it is case-sensitive and needs a quote/paren boundary.

#### Minor
3. Other stale names: README.md:54 "menu: Safety → The Room"; help-topics-more.ts:91 button label 'Open The Room' (page is "Room"); wf-wire.spec.ts:111 title "next to Swarm Topology"; comments still say "Learning Lab"/"Memory Lab" (views/neural.ts:95, memory-lab.ts), optional.
4. Nav search no longer finds old names: dropping "the Memory Lab" from Memory's blurb means findPages('memory lab') and findPages('learning lab') return nothing, and 'lab' no longer lists Memory. Consider keeping "lab" keywords in blurbs.
5. Weak assertions: views.test.ts:1549 and nav.test.ts:59 no longer discriminate; assert exact menu items or found-list entries instead.

### Assessment
**Task quality:** Needs fixes
**Reasoning:** The derivation is correct and complete (membership, order, names, accents all from NAV_GROUPS, no page lost). But the rename leaves `/ruflo learning lab` and the same words at the menu prompt unresolvable while help text still teaches it, a command a person might type and a break of "one label everywhere". Cheap fix: a viewOf alias plus a help-text edit.
